items.description: Auto Ontology is a Python framework for building semantic, graph-based reasoning layers over data. It enables deterministic query generation, better context retrieval, and more explainable AI for LLM and agent workflows.
items.description_zh: Auto Ontology 是一个 Python 框架，用于在数据上构建语义、基于图形的推理层。它为法学硕士和代理工作流程提供确定性查询生成、更好的上下文检索以及更可解释的人工智能。

items.description: Worktrunk is a CLI for Git worktree management, designed for parallel AI agent workflows
items.description_zh: Worktrunk 是一个用于 Git 工作树管理的 CLI，专为并行 AI 代理工作流程而设计

items.description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
items.description_zh: 真正工程师的技能。直接来自我的 .agents 目录。

items.description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
items.description_zh: 每个座席跨会话的持久上下文 – 捕获座席在会话期间所做的所有操作，使用 AI 对其进行压缩，并将相关上下文注入到未来的会话中。适用于 Claude Code、OpenClaw、Codex、Gemini、Hermes、Copilot、OpenCode 等

items.description: Get production-ready images, video, audio, and 3D from any AI agent: skills that pick the right model, price before spending, and keep characters and brands consistent through the Scenario MCP, plus expert teams that drive Blender, Maya, ZBrush, Unreal, and Unity.
items.description_zh: 从任何 AI 代理处获取可立即投入生产的图像、视频、音频和 3D：通过场景 MCP 以及驱动 Blender、Maya、ZBrush、Unreal 和 Unity 的专家团队，选择正确的模型、购买前定价并保持角色和品牌一致的技能。
